test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language,** 'ORDER' **is written as **'PTGIW'** and **'BRAND'** is written as** 'CTDRI'**. How will 'SHAPE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df1b709a6043a9f42799117583a4467a7f1931144ae1e4468aa56c9ca64754b2.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'ORDER' is written as 'PTGIW' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a328f9cdf790e70015c0e1a2b8269224d8aa04e38b2a9eca3ff8be0e0e685d0.png] 

'BRAND' is written as 'CTDRI'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3574ac7dfad9b7175f877985c590cebc4a2e2a40b9e8a0c3bd63a4272d947a06.png] 

Similarly, '**SHAPE**' be written:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24ff93cd78714eda4c20fa268dba890717e2d30833f2117ff2c6fa357a5a54d3.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"TJDTJ".**
